content.title: 2020 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Management of Valvular Heart Disease

details: Focuses on the echocardiographic assessment of valvular morphology and hemodynamics.
Discusses outcomes of percutaneous mitral valvuloplasty versus open surgical commissurotomy.
Highlights the use of Doppler echocardiography in stress conditions.
